purpose: Non-profit scientific investigation and independently implemented behavioral reconstruction of Cubase for macOS, directed with morluto/rea.

target.selection_reason: Current build on the official download page at study start, broadest edition, matching operation manual, publicly accessible macOS installer.
target.other_architecture_status: Inventory first; x86_64/Rosetta behavior is a separate configuration.
target.edition_note: The official page describes a single installer for all editions; the license selects the running edition. Bundle inspection alone does not verify Pro functionality.
target.acquisition_scope: Complete official installer and native package extraction; full application static signature verification and separate eight VST3 checks complete. No installation or target execution.
target.integrity_evidence: Independent 69-segment and whole-image hashes; native DMG checksum; 49 XAR data checksums and 11 gzip streams; native package signature/notary observation; strict/deep/all-architectures app and eight VST3 verification. No independent fresh online revocation check.

host.limitation: Local macOS 27 is outside the published support list. Runtime observations here do not establish behavior on a supported configuration.

tooling.native_provider_verification_scope: Scoped doctor healthy; synthetic ARM64 controls plus actual Cubase component function dossiers. Retained findings distinguish synthetic readiness from target static evidence; no target execution.
tooling.rea_mcp_registration: Project-local CLI and persistent stdio MCP sessions; no global client registration.

evidence_classes.documented: A primary source says this; not measured in the target.
evidence_classes.static_observation: Exact artifact bytes, structures, instructions, or references, with digest and location.
evidence_classes.runtime_observation: A reproducible action on the identified target/configuration and its retained output.
evidence_classes.inference: A proposed explanation connecting observations; alternatives and disconfirming probes required.
evidence_classes.synthetic_control: An instrument test using our own data or executable; not Cubase evidence.
evidence_classes.candidate_conformance: An independently implemented candidate matches named reference cases under declared criteria.

acceptance.claim_unit: Named observable behavior under a fully identified configuration, stimulus and state history.
acceptance.promotion_rule: Require repeatable reference evidence, independent candidate output, negative controls, held-out compound scenarios and retained failures. Neither decompilation nor harness success establishes Cubase fidelity.

runtime: Deferred at explicit user instruction: Proceed with static analysis first.

candidate.basis: Static instructions and literal table bytes
candidate.independent_review: No actionable defect within declared candidate domain.

application.user_clarification: this does include building the application - you do realise?
application.platform: Native macOS 14+; SwiftUI/AppKit, AVFoundation, reviewed C processor, ZIPFoundation 0.9.20
application.project_format: Independent .rebaseproj bundle, strict audio-only DAWproject 1.0 subset, and reviewed CPR subset import with unchanged original/report preserved. No CPR writer or complete compatibility.
implemented: media import and copied project assets
project open/save and independent Save As
waveform timeline, clip move/end trim/split/delete, and undo/redo
jump tempo maps and bar-boundary signature maps
linear or musical track time bases; musical clip starts follow tempo-map edits without stretching audio
bar/beat/quantize snap and grid-relative movement within one signature region
editable read-enabled gain-dB and pan automation with per-point outgoing linear/step interpolation and per-sample application
deterministic stereo float32 WAV export using the shared prepared audio
strict audio-only DAWproject import/export with referenced media, seconds clips, mixer values, jump maps and supported automation
standalone 4/9/16-channel Ambisonic file conversion in float32/float64 using restricted static-derived operators

Bounded CPR profile-v2 import recovers ordered empty audio tracks, a verified shared fixed-tempo clock with native Float32 period and binary64 operation order, and a simple origin meter only when compact and typed records agree. Original bytes and versioned reports remain preserved; frozen v1 reports replay unchanged. Active native clocks must match the source-replayed report on load/save. Wrong interface roles use an explicit 120 BPM application default; unsupported native state never becomes playable content.
Explicit native-to-application timing conversion retains musical anchors; untouched signature edits retain native timing. Persistence binds active clock provenance to the replayed preserved source.
remaining_scope: audio/MIDI recording and automation writing modes
VST hosting, live multichannel inserts, groups and sends
tempo ramps, time stretch, swing/grooves and broader timing semantics
Full CPR event/media/MIDI/mixer/plugin/map compatibility and writing; broader DAWproject semantics/runtime interoperability
remaining bundled DSP and lifecycle behavior
complete Cubase UI and behavioral fidelity
application.playback_edit_limitation: Prepared clip buffers are rebuilt and playback restarts at the current position; continuous realtime mixing remains pending.
application.save_policy: Named projects save explicitly; unsaved New/Open/Quit guarded; scratch sessions keep recovery copy. Save As creates independent package without writing original.
application.meter: Actual engine stereo output buffer peaks; no DAC measurement
application.tempo_status: General jump tempo/signature maps, anchors and snapping remain application policies. CPR profile-v2 additionally retains bounded native fixed-tempo arithmetic: Float32(60) / stored Float32 BPM, widened to Double, 480 native ticks per quarter, exact multiply/divide order, nearest rounding and a bounded nonnegative finite normal-or-zero input domain. Only a matching single compact/typed origin signature is recovered. Native variable maps, ramps, further signature changes/display semantics, stretching and swing remain unsupported.
application.automation_status: Editable read gainDB/pan lanes evaluate at absolute project sample time. Gain interpolation is in dB, pan in bipolar value space; outgoing point interpolation is linear or step. No Touch/AutoLatch/Overwrite recording state machine or native interpolation equivalence is claimed.
application.exchange_status: Strict DAWproject 1.0 audio subset with transactional import/export and referenced-media extraction. Unsupported routing/devices, musical anchors, ramps, missing interpolation and unrepresented automation reject. An active native clock requires explicit Use Rebase Timing conversion before exchange; it is never silently serialized as generic BPM math. Local roundtrips/XSD checks are not Cubase runtime interoperability.
application.ambisonic_status: Standalone IEEE-float WAV conversion for 4/9/16 channels and both precisions/directions. Float64 storage is preserved; the reviewed processor has explicit sample/FP/state restrictions. No live insert, VST host ABI, or target runtime parity is established.
application.evidence_boundary: 92 Swift tests in13 suites,36 analytical exact vectors,static/source reviews and12 bounded native Rebase GUI groups verify this implementation slice. No Cubase runtime or reference conformance case is complete.
application.cpr_status: Bounded CPR profile-v2 import recovers ordered empty audio tracks, a verified shared fixed-tempo clock with native Float32 period and binary64 operation order, and a simple origin meter only when compact and typed records agree. Original bytes and versioned reports remain preserved; frozen v1 reports replay unchanged. Active native clocks must match the source-replayed report on load/save. Wrong interface roles use an explicit 120 BPM application default; unsupported native state never becomes playable content.
application.build_status: 0.4.0 build4 release built;strict local codesign verification passed.
application.gui_validation_status: 12 bounded Rebase GUI check groups passed;three persisted packages and converted XML export independently verified.
application.native_clock_edit_policy: Tempo changes and DAWproject export require explicit Use Rebase Timing conversion. Conversion is applied atomically, preserves musical anchors and recalculates seconds; cancellation/untouched map edits retain the clock.
